long:
Have you been doing all the right things for your health but still don't feel the way you want to? Or perhaps you sense that stress, life experiences, and nervous system patterns are playing a role in your health issues.

At Root Cause Health Coaching, I take an integrative approach that brings together functional medicine, nervous system regulation, and somatic practices. Rather than looking at symptoms or health habits in isolation, we'll explore how the different pieces of your life and health connect.

My goal is to help you better understand what's influencing your well-being and support you in making changes that feel realistic, meaningful, and sustainable. Our work is collaborative, individualized, and grounded in curiosity about you as a whole person.

Virtual coaching and in-person sessions in the 18074 area.
